name: Null Meridian
description: A documentary assembled from leaked internal footage, intercepted comms, and survivor testimony documenting the systematic displacement of Shelf communities in the 2190s to make way for Vantablack Media's Lakeside Content Campus. The film names specific executives, includes authenticated financial records, and features an extended segment on the 'soft clearance' methodology — a legally deniable process of cutting utilities and services until populations self-evacuate. Runtime is four hours and eleven minutes; no version has ever been officially distributed.
cultural_impact: Null Meridian is cited by underground journalists as the most important document of corporate land violence in the M88 era, circulated in fragments on pirate mesh networks where a complete copy is considered almost mythological.
story_hooks: A complete copy of Null Meridian exists on a single physical chip, and multiple factions — corporate, activist, and criminal — are all trying to locate it.
One of the missing directors has been living under a false identity in a Tier 2 district and wants to finish a sequel.
A Vantablack executive who appears in the leaked footage is now running for a municipal governance seat and will do anything to keep the film buried.
